ev.q: The story is hands down the best part of this game
The story and the connection between Joel and Ellie
I felt genuinely connected to the characters
watching Ellie lose the people she cares about, one by one, is heartbreaking
Guide Joel and Ellie through a post-apocalyptic America
Stealth, combat, and resource management are satisfying
the combat feels heavy and realistic
how difficult it is to survive in it
The graphics in this PC version look absolutely beautiful
The whole atmosphere is tense and keeps you focused the entire time
the ending leaves you thinking about it for days
There are basically 4 things you do on repeat
even if some encounters get repetitive
The ending I also thought was stupid
